_comment: The cross-language node-registry parity fixture (TASK-734 Task 3, extended by TASK-724 Task 3 with the eight STT-palette node types — stt.phiHop is implemented:false, a documented placeholder pending TASK-710). Asserted from BOTH packages/workflow-contract/src/__tests__/node-registry-parity.test.ts (TS) and apps/harness/src/harness/tests/unit/temporal/interpreter/test_node_registry_parity.py (Python) — see packages/workflow-contract/src/node-registry.ts's module docstring for why the two sides check against this file instead of against each other. `entries` sorted by `key`. Only fields BOTH registries carry today are listed here; `classes`/`paletteKey` (TS-only) and `kind` (Python-only) are intentionally excluded. NOTE (2026-08-16, TASK-724 execution): TASK-720's summarization-palette entries are currently absent from both registries — a concurrent sibling session's uncommitted work was reverted mid-session by an external tree operation (see docs/implementation/TASK-724-Palette-Stt/README.md §7). This fixture reflects the registries' actual current content (noop/passthrough + stt.*); TASK-720's own reconciliation will re-add its five entries on top of this.
